beats.say: Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo have defined the Ballon d'Or era.
While Messi holds the record with eight wins, Ronaldo has the most nominations.
He was shortlisted eighteen times during his career.
Messi also achieved something no other player has managed.
He is the only person to win the trophy while playing for three different clubs.
Stanley Matthews won at forty-one, while Brazil's Ronaldo was only twenty-one.

facts: Lionel Messi has won the Ballon d'Or a record eight times.
Cristiano Ronaldo earned the most nominations with eighteen.
Stanley Matthews was the oldest player to ever win it at 41 years old.
Ronaldo of Brazil is the youngest winner ever at 21 years old.
Lionel Messi is the only player to win the award with three clubs.
